exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to lead, to preside over, to chair
to lead, to conduct, to guide, to steer, to take
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вести́ — to lead, to preside over, to chair; привести́ — to bring (someone with); провести́ — to lead, to conduct, to guide, to steer, to take; проводи́ть — to spend (time), to pass.
**произвожу** — производи́ть (imperfective): to make, to carry out, to execute, to effect; to give birth; to promote; to cause, to produce, to create. Wiktionary: про- + из- + води́ть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?
